text: {"lessons":["I have repeatedly sold positions only when they were above my average cost; I should not let the satisfaction of locking in gains or the pain of realizing losses decide whether to hold or sell.","My account value fell despite those profitable sales, so I should judge decisions by the whole portfolio’s risk and future prospects, not just gains in each stock since purchase.","Past price moves do not predict future moves; I should avoid trying to time trades from price history and keep a diversified portfolio suited to my risk tolerance."]}
